checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Both hands and entire blue sheet visible on wooden table
must.why: Both hands and the full sheet are visible in all frames on a wood table.

must.item: Hands bring one half over the other, producing a fold rather than abrupt replacement
must.why: At 0.8s the sheet already looks mostly folded or flap held; the sheet size is about the same in every frame. The result looks like a full sheet with a crease, not a half-size folded sheet. No clear fold is visible.

must.item: Hands press along the crease after folding
must.why: At 3.2s and 5.6s the hands press on the paper near the crease.

must.item: Hands anatomically plausible with convincing contact
must.why: Five fingers each, reasonable. Slight blur at 3.2s, but acceptable.

must.item: Blue paper remains a single consistent object
must.why: The sheet changes shape and size between frames (it goes from a tall flap to a square-ish sheet). At the end it is unfolded with a crease, so the paper does not stay consistent.

must.item: 8s widescreen, fixed overhead shot, no sound
must.why: The framing is a fixed overhead 16:9 view. Sound cannot be verified, but the agent said there is none.

faults.what: The paper is not clearly folded in half. The sheet stays full size and ends up flat with only a crease line, so the fold looks like a morph or an unfold.
The paper's shape and edges shift between frames (flap in view at 0.8s, creased sheet later), which is an AI artefact.
The hands are slightly blurred and the pressing at 3.2s looks awkward.

summary: The video is a realistic fixed overhead shot with plausible hands on a wooden table, but the sheet never visibly folds in half; it stays full size with a crease, so the core action fails.
